output: Machine learning is a subset of AI where computers learn patterns from data.

instruction: Explain what a neural network is.
output: A neural network is a computing system inspired by biological neural networks.
Python is a high-level programming language known for its readability.
Overfitting is when a model learns noise in training data instead of patterns.
A GPU is a specialized processor designed for parallel computation.
LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) is a technique to fine-tune large models efficiently.
Tokenization is the process of splitting text into smaller units called tokens.
Transfer learning uses a pre-trained model as a starting point for a new task.
An epoch is one complete pass through the entire training dataset.
Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm that minimizes loss iteratively.
A loss function measures how far model predictions are from actual values.
Batch size is the number of training samples processed before updating weights.
Quantization reduces model precision (e.g., 32-bit to 4-bit) to save memory.
Attention lets models focus on relevant parts of input when generating output.
Fine-tuning is training a pre-trained model on task-specific data.
Learning rate controls how much model weights change during each training step.
A transformer is a neural network architecture based on self-attention.
Backpropagation computes gradients by propagating errors backward through layers.
RLHF trains models using human feedback as a reward signal.
Inference is using a trained model to make predictions on new data.
